MASTER SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Master Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of 2 March
2026 ("Effective Date") between SOLSTICE RETAIL GROUP, INC., a Delaware
corporation ("Client"), and COBALT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS, LLC, a California
limited liability company ("Vendor").

1. TERM. This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for
three (3) years unless earlier terminated as provided herein.

2. SERVICES AND STATEMENTS OF WORK. Vendor shall perform services pursuant
to one or more Statements of Work executed by both Parties, each referencing
this Agreement by date and identified by a unique SOW number (e.g.,
"SOW-001"). Each Statement of Work shall be governed by the terms of this
Agreement unless expressly stated otherwise in that Statement of Work.

3. PAYMENT TERMS. Undisputed invoices are payable within forty-five (45)
days of the invoice date (net-45).

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Subject to full payment, all work product created
specifically for Client under a Statement of Work shall be owned by Client
upon delivery. Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, methods,
and platforms, and grants Client a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use
such pre-existing materials solely as incorporated into the delivered work
product.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Except for breaches of confidentiality
obligations or gross negligence/willful misconduct, each Party's aggregate
liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by Client to
Vendor in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

6. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience
upon sixty (60) days' written notice, or for material breach upon fifteen
(15) days' written notice if the breach remains uncured.

7. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of
Delaware.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the
Effective Date.

For SOLSTICE RETAIL GROUP, INC.          For COBALT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS, LLC
